name: Start AI Project
description: Bootstrap sandboxes from local repositories for coding-agent workflows.

repoListPath.label: Repo List Path
repoListPath.help: Optional markdown/json path that enumerates selectable repositories.

reposRoot.label: Repositories Root
reposRoot.help: Optional base directory used to resolve local repo paths.

sandboxRoot.label: Sandbox Root
sandboxRoot.help: Root directory where per-run sandbox copies are created.

groupRepoFilters.label: Group Repo Filters
groupRepoFilters.help: Optional map of group chat ids to allowed repo ids. DMs still show all repos.
